title: Ready Day on the Dispensing Channel Calendar, Member-Opened Formulary Benefit Exception Requests
content:
## Rule

For a member who opens their own exception request under the Formulary Benefit, the ready day is the day by which the member could have the drug in hand. It is reckoned on the calendar of the dispensing channel of the member's latest fill of the drug.

- **Building the ready day.** Every wait counted for the request is a number of calendar days from the handling date. Their sum is the member's total wait. The ready day is the date that falls that many whole days after the handling date.
- **Home delivery.** When the member's latest fill of the drug was a Home Delivery Pharmacy order, a ready day that falls on a Saturday or a Sunday is moved to the following Monday, because the home delivery pharmacy ships only Monday through Friday.
- **Retail.** When the latest fill was at a retail pharmacy under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit, a ready day that falls on a Sunday is moved to the following Monday, because network pharmacies dispense Monday through Saturday.
- **Otherwise.** The ready day is taken as it falls.
- **Which fill is latest.** The latest fill is the member's latest paid retail fill of the drug when its date of service is later than the date of the latest shipped home delivery order. Otherwise it is that home delivery order.
- **Days to the ready day.** The days counted to the ready day are the member's total wait together with the days by which the ready day was moved: two for a Saturday moved to Monday, one for a Sunday moved to Monday. The request is expedited when the member's days left are fewer than these days.

## Calendar table (hypothetical handling date on a Wednesday)

| Total wait | Ready day as it falls | Latest fill by home delivery | Latest fill at retail |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 days | Saturday | Monday, 5 days | Saturday, 3 days |
| 4 days | Sunday | Monday, 5 days | Monday, 5 days |
| 5 days | Monday | Monday, 5 days | Monday, 5 days |

*Reading.* Suppose a member has 4 days left, a total wait of 3 days, and a latest fill by home delivery. The days to the ready day are 5, and 4 is fewer than 5, so the request is expedited. Had the latest fill been at retail, the days would be 3, and 4 is not fewer than 3.
